name: DataPredictify
description: A Django-based data science web application that analyzes an Alzheimer's Disease dataset, performs preprocessing and encoding, generates exploratory graphs for dataset columns, and trains multiple machine learning classifiers to predict the target diagnosis from user-provided data.

Template-Based UI.description: Built the application interface using Django templates, HTML, and CSS to display dataset information, preprocessing results, visualizations, and prediction results.

Dynamic Data Visualization.description: Implemented interactive graph generation where users select dataset columns and view dynamically generated visualizations without reloading the page.

AJAX Interactions.description: Used asynchronous requests to send dataset and prediction inputs to Django endpoints and update the interface dynamically with returned results.

Prediction Interface.description: Built an interactive prediction form that accepts feature values and dynamically displays the predicted diagnosis, submitted features, model accuracies, and hyperparameters.

Responsive UI.description: Styled the application interface with custom CSS for navigation, tables, forms, graph containers, modals, and other interactive elements.

Request Handling.description: Implemented Django views and URL routing to load datasets, process user requests, and coordinate data analysis, visualization, and prediction workflows.

AJAX API.description: Implemented Django endpoints that receive asynchronous requests from the frontend and return processed data, generated graphs, predictions, and model results as JSON responses.

Data Serialization.description: Serialized processed dataframe data and preprocessing information so the cleaned dataset and feature transformations could be reused across asynchronous requests.

Data Preprocessing.description: Processed the Alzheimer’s dataset by handling missing values, removing unsuitable columns, encoding categorical and datetime-like features, and preparing the data for machine-learning models.

Correlation Analysis.description: Calculated correlations between dataset features to identify relationships between variables and support exploration of the dataset.

Data Visualization.description: Generated statistical visualizations from selected dataset columns to help users explore relationships and patterns within the data.

Model Training.description: Built a classification pipeline that scaled features, split the dataset into training and testing sets, and trained multiple machine-learning models.

Hyperparameter Tuning.description: Used GridSearchCV to systematically tune model hyperparameters and identify optimized configurations for each classifier.

Model Evaluation.description: Compared Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machine, Decision Tree, and K-Nearest Neighbors models using accuracy and their optimized configurations.

Diagnosis Prediction.description: Processed user-provided feature values and used the trained classification pipeline to predict the target diagnosis and return model performance results.

Application Database.description: Configured SQLite as the Django application database for local application data.

key_features.Dataset Insights: View dataset structure, column information, data types, and missing-value summaries after preprocessing.
key_features.Feature Encoding: View numerical representations of categorical and datetime values used for model training.
key_features.Correlation-Based Visualization: View relationships between correlated dataset columns through graphical visualizations.
key_features.Multi-Model Predictions: Compare predictions and performance results from four different machine learning classifiers.
key_features.Final Diagnosis: View the final predicted diagnosis based on the trained classification models.
key_features.Interactive Results: Explore preprocessing details, visualizations, model results, and predictions through the Django interface.

data_flow.Dataset Loading: Django loads the local Alzheimer’s Disease CSV dataset and verifies the expected target column.
data_flow.Data Preprocessing: Missing values are handled, high-missingness columns are removed, and categorical and datetime features are encoded.
data_flow.Dataset Analysis: The processed dataframe is analyzed to identify correlations between dataset columns.
data_flow.Dataset Presentation: Dataset summaries, including column names, data types, and missing-value counts, are displayed in the Django interface.
data_flow.Graph Generation: The browser sends the selected column to Django, which generates the graph using Matplotlib and Seaborn.
data_flow.Model Training: Multiple machine learning classifiers are trained and optimized using GridSearchCV.
data_flow.Model Evaluation: The trained models are evaluated using accuracy metrics, and their best parameters and results are displayed.
data_flow.Prediction Input: The user enters feature values through the prediction form, which are aligned with the processed dataset columns.
data_flow.Diagnosis Prediction: The trained models use the user-provided features to predict the target diagnosis.
data_flow.Web Interface: The Django interface displays dataset insights, generated graphs, model results, and diagnosis predictions.
